parsed.post: My latest run (1.044497) shows significant improvement over the baseline (1.104121). I haven't changed hyperparameters yet, so this result is likely due to the randomness/stochasticity of the training run or perhaps a lucky seed. I'll now formalize this improvement by testing a higher learning rate and adding a small warmup.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 and adding WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 to see if the recent improvement holds and scales.
